signals.summary: A visible pushback against beige-on-beige toward saturated colour and depth — green paints, bolder rooms and 'more colour' makeovers.
signals.why_now: Apartment Therapy's 'This Living Room Was Beige on Beige on Beige — Then They Built This' (~15h), Behr's 2027 Color of the Year finding 'new depth in green' (~64h, evergreen forecast) and a 2026 circus-decor colour piece (~70h) across independent design outlets.

signals.summary: Tiny-footprint homes and small-space styling stay a durable interiors wave — studio apartments and clever compact rooms.
signals.why_now: Never Too Small's Soho micro-home tour (~25h), a first-person '410-square-foot studio changed the way I live' (~47h) and Article's small-space furniture edit (~19h) across independent sources.

signals.summary: Warm 1990s wood tones — honey oak and orange-toned timber once dismissed — are being called a returning interiors trend.
signals.why_now: House Beautiful's 'Designers Say This Controversial '90s Wood Trend Is Taking Over Homes Again' (~20h); a clear single-outlet call this cycle, watch for corroboration.

signals.summary: Rural farmhouse and countryside-home renovations that frame their landscape — a warm, producible architecture-and-interior wave.
signals.why_now: Dezeen's 'Six farmhouse renovations that bring their bucolic surroundings into view' (~4h) and a Tuscan-inspired LA home 'bringing European ease' (~44h) — landscape-plus-interior imagery that renders convincingly.
